column1: # Keyboard layouts and the key combination that switches between them.
# Two sections in one file, told apart by the kind column.
#   layout  a layout a recipe may name, as keyboard: (Latin only) or second_script: (anything).
#           The Latin-only rule on keyboard: is a safety rule, not a preference: the login screen
#           and the disk-unlock prompt come up before any input method is running, so a fleet whose
#           primary layout cannot type a password is a fleet nobody can log into.
#   toggle  a switch_scripts_with: value and the xkb option that implements it.
#   name    as written in a recipe
#   xkb     xkb layout[:variant] for a layout; the xkb option for a toggle
#   script  the script this layout types, for a layout; - for a toggle
